ActorTalk: What a coincidence, Commandant of Gray Raven. Liv is part of your squad, right?
Glad I got that right. Oh, by the way, my classmates and I want to get something to thank her.
We just want to put something together to thank her properly, that's all.
Yes. She's been coming by a lot to help care for the plants. I thought it was a mission at first, but it turns out she's doing it on her own initiative.
There are plenty of people like her, but for some reason, every plant she tends grows especially well. Some of them are even part of our research...
Ahem... if I keep talking, this could take a while. Long story short, we want to get Liv a thank-you gift. What do you think would be good?
Give her something that feels meaningful to you.
I see. A biosphere... alright, I'll talk it over with my classmates. Thanks for the suggestion.
Something meaningful... maybe new microbial cultures, or synthetic fertilizer... no, I should think this through a bit more.
